ensure everything has guardrails running through it ... step action blueprints once created goes through reviews in the following stages

payload.name: Automatic Behaviors Have Switches Default On
payload.description: Every automatic behavior passes through the guardrail path and has a named kill switch that defaults to on. A host turns a behavior off in its own configuration; the shipped default stays on.

principles.name: Defaults are the product
principles.description: What ships is on; an off state is a local choice recorded in config.

principles.name: A switch never changes a guard
principles.description: Turning a behavior off stops it from running; it never changes what a guard decides.

heuristics.condition: a behavior has no way to turn it off
heuristics.action: add the switch before it is deployed

heuristics.condition: a plan says 'deploy with the switches off'
heuristics.action: check the operator's ruling: the shipped default stays on and the hosts opt out in their config

decision_rules.name: Give it a switch
decision_rules.condition: an automatic behavior is added (a loop, publisher, creator, gate or actor)
decision_rules.outcome: give it a named switch read from configuration or environment, documented with the behavior

decision_rules.name: Default on
decision_rules.outcome: make the default on; a host that wants it off sets it off in its own config

decision_rules.name: Pass through guardrails
decision_rules.outcome: route the action through the guardrail path (rule gate, jurisdiction, approval, review stages) before it has effect

decision_rules.name: Record host state
decision_rules.condition: a host runs with a switch off
decision_rules.outcome: note which switches are off on which host and why, so the state is known and not assumed

decision_rules.name: Review created actions
decision_rules.condition: a blueprint step or action is created
decision_rules.outcome: let it pass each review stage that follows creation, and capture each review result
